note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown in the original, so that section is not included; the description of this species is based on an unpublished manuscript by Bose; literature citations and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel, mandibles almost as long as the head capsule, apical beak of the left mandible short, the part below the beak broad and transverse; total length about 6.95–7.00 mm. Worker head capsule subcircular, antennae 14-segmented, total length 3.30–3.40 mm. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, antennae pale brown, mandibles dark brown with paler bases, thorax and abdomen milk-white; head and body rather densely setose; total length about 6.95–7.00. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel (length to mandibular base 1.87–2.00, maximum width 1.35–1.40, ratio of width to length 0.70–0.722); frons weakly inclined forward; coronal suture short, extending from the posterior margin to slightly more than one quarter of the head length. Fontanelle transverse, at the base of the frons, about three-quarters of the head length from the posterior margin of the head. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus semicircular, with one seta on each side anteriorly, not distinctly delimited from the frons. Anteclypeus translucent, subtrapezoidal, glabrous. Labrum translucent, anterolateral angles sharp and long, short setae on the anterior margin and on the disc, anterior margin deeply incurved (length 0.35–0.40, width 0.28–0.33). Mandibles asymmetrical, almost as long as the head capsule (left 1.87–2.00, right 1.88–2.00, ratio of left mandible length to head length 1.00–1.07). Left mandible with a short apical beak, the part below the beak broad, transverse and blade-like, moderately incurved behind it. Right mandible pointed apically and with a long apical blade, outer margin weakly incurved. Postmentum short and clavate (length 1.00–1.05, maximum width 0.40–0.45, waist width 0.25–0.30), waist near the posterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a concavity, posterior margin without an indentation (length 0.40–0.42, width 0.80–0.82). Dorsal spur of the fore tibia indistinguishable.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule milk-white, legs white, abdomen greyish through the gut contents; head and body rather densely setose; total length 3.30–3.40. Head subcircular (length to mandibular base 0.75–0.85, maximum width 0.95–1.03). Frontal plate circular and translucent (diameter 0.13). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus arched and setose, slightly less than half as long as wide (length 0.20–0.22, width 0.53–0.55), anterior margin straight, posterior margin weakly concave. Anteclypeus trapezoidal and glabrous, anterior margin projecting at the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a concavity (length 0.25–0.28, width 0.55–0.60).
